name: @polymech/pm-audio
description: Portable audio session, ElevenLabs clients, voice-over, and the sound trigger. Settings, models, and LLM speech stay in the host.

scripts.build:cpp: npm run configure && node scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset dev --target pm-audio
scripts.build:cpp:release: npm run configure:release && node scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset release --target pm-audio
